qualifications.summary: Recorded decision replay on a known development regression set. No new solver inference, untouched holdout or learner-growth measurement.
This dataset contains 11 usable structure items without explicit emphasis spans: 7 train and 4 test. C3 comparisons are provisional pending capture verification.
E1 v2 routes the Argument Judge by subtype alone. EXCEPT tasks can receive an inappropriate ranking direction, and the Judge can override a correct Solver answer.
E1 v2 B1 retains the initial Solver confidence after a Judge override. Its ECE is not validated as confidence in the final decision.
Known development data; source repairs and fixture changes are versioned. No untouched holdout, human explanation ratings or 99.9% reliability certification.

Constructed mutations share eight parent items. Controls and capture limitations differ by protocol version. Not independent population defect samples or evidence of learner benefit.

Fresh paired local pilot with source-keyed labels. Repeated passes are correlated; results do not establish untouched-holdout generalization, human explanation quality or learner growth.
Restored-format development cohorts. Fifteen completion questions observed twice are not thirty independent items. Input guard contracts do not prove whole-source fidelity or semantic reliability.
Twenty matched original generation tasks. First-draft verification by same-model agents is an AI proxy, not human item quality or learner benefit; v1 memory-size study remains unexecuted.

Source-key agreement on a frozen newly acquired source set; possible model pretraining exposure and no independent human adjudication. Equal uncached token-price ceilings do not imply identical actual spending. The same-model verifier is correlated with its Solver. No production adoption, human explanation or learner-benefit claim.
